title: Uniform expectation of a point indicator
statement: Let $\{a,b,c\}$ be a set of three elements with the uniform probability distribution, and let the indicator of $c$ equal $1$ at $c$ and $0$ at the other two elements. Its expectation is $1/3$.
hypotheses_covered: sample space consists of the three elements $a,b,c$
